login.title: Sign in
login.mfaHint: 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a backup code (xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx).

validation.mfaCode: Enter a 6-digit code or a backup code

verification.required: Please verify your email before signing in.
verification.sent: If your account needs verification, a new email is on its way.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.name: Name
signup.emailHint: Use an address such as name{'@'}example.com, without spaces.
signup.passwordHint: At least {min} characters, with a lowercase letter (a–z), an uppercase letter (A–Z), a digit (0–9) and another character (e.g. ! or a space). Avoid common passwords and number sequences, even within a longer password.

success.title: Check your email
success.description: We've sent you an email with the next step. Follow the link to continue, or sign in if you already have an account.

validation.email: Enter a valid email address without spaces
validation.symbol: Must contain a character other than a–z, A–Z or 0–9 (e.g. ! or a space)
validation.common: Contains a common password or sequence; choose a less predictable password

errors.weakPassword: Password does not meet the policy

errors.missing: This link is missing the token or signature.
errors.generic: We couldn't sign you in with that link. Try `battlestack login` again to generate a fresh one.
